article.title: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
article.summary: Patients travel miles to be treated at public hospitals in Delhi. Those in need get financial aid for their care. But for overnight accommodations, families are often on their own — and on the street. (Image credit: Sajad Hameed for NPR)
